meta.name: playwright-cli
meta.description: Automate browser interactions, test web pages and work with Playwright tests.

copy.tagline: 自动化浏览器交互与网页测试
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要用代码操控浏览器进行自动化测试或操作网页。
copy.tagline_en: Automate browser interactions and test web pages
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to automate browser interactions or test web pages with code.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以控制浏览器打开网页、点击、输入文字、截图、录制视频、模拟网络请求等，并返回页面快照。
howto.when: 当你要求 Claude 操作浏览器、测试网页或进行 UI 审查时触发。

say.text: 打开百度首页，搜索“天气”。
say.note: Claude 会打开浏览器，导航到百度，输入搜索词并提交。

say.text: 帮我截图当前页面，保存为 screenshot.png。
say.note: Claude 会执行截图命令并保存文件。

say.text: 打开 example.com，点击登录按钮，然后填写表单。
say.note: Claude 会依次执行打开、点击、填写等操作。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can control a browser to open web pages, click, type, take screenshots, record videos, mock network requests, etc., and return page snapshots.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask Claude to interact with a browser, test a web page, or perform a UI review.

say_en.text: Open Baidu homepage and search for 'weather'.
say_en.note: Claude will open the browser, navigate to Baidu, type the query, and submit.

say_en.text: Take a screenshot of the current page and save it as screenshot.png.
say_en.note: Claude will execute the screenshot command and save the file.

say_en.text: Open example.com, click the login button, then fill in the form.
say_en.note: Claude will sequentially open, click, and fill actions.
